user.t:
You are re-reviewing the final fix wave of a whole-branch review. Verdict each finding and inspect the fix diff only. Not a fresh review.

## Context
Branch feat/console-chat of the ruflo-console Claude Code plugin (worktree C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-chat). Implementer report: C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\pr-c-final-fix-report.md
Global constraints (verbatim): transcript text is never written to disk, never placed in `console_state` text answers, never sent to a model by the console itself (ADR-486); the module must pass `claude plugin validate`.

## Findings to verdict
1. A chat refusal was wiped by the following refreshChat (`delete chat.error`). Required: separate sendError, cleared only when the next send starts; visible until then.
2. Tool-result-only user rows (text '') drew as empty "you" frames and used up the caps. Required: drop user rows with text '' and assistant rows with no text and no tools; a spec from a realistic tool-loop transcript.
3. Drawn transcript text skipped termText cleaning. Required: termText (escape/control/bidi/invisible stripped, invite codes masked) on every drawn message line and on the partial; tests with ANSI, bidi override, invite code.
4. Uncontrolled Send field. Required: in-memory draft (never in snapshot/state/console_state), cleared on accepted send, kept on refusal; repeated Enter while sending/queued shows a fixed note.
5. Missing kit tests. Required: tests/chat.test.ts — open shows messages, Enter submits once, console_state has no text, preview off hides text, Enter clears field after accepted send, refusal stays visible and keeps the text.
6. appendPartial fed with Session preview off. Required: gated on sessionPreview, tested.
7. (a) `{drop}` from prompt.submit surfaced as a fixed "not sent: a hook declined it" (no echo); (b) newline between turn steps in partial; (c) stale comment fixed; (d) tests for consumer early close and upstream throw through chatStep.

Judge also the implementer's notes: the refused text (possibly a secret) is kept in an in-memory draft table outside Chat/State so the person can edit it — confirm it can never reach snapshot, persistence, console_state, events, the model, or an export (grep the draft table's uses); the help topic was not updated — is any help text now wrong about the field's behaviour?; an unchanged ask-claude spec ("ask Claude keeps submitting without asUser") times out in a full run but passes alone — run that spec file alone once to confirm it passes.

handback.t:
All seven findings are addressed, and I found no new breakage in the fix diff. I read the whole diff and ran three vitest files from plugins/ruflo-console. `ask-claude.spec.ts` ran alone and passed 10/10, and `chat-view.spec.ts` plus `chat-send.spec.ts` passed 54/54. I did not run `tests/chat.test.ts` (the kit tests) or the full suite, so those pass only on the diff reading.

**Findings**
1. ADDRESSED (hooks/chat.ts:191, 227-233, 259-262; hooks/views/chat.ts:~100-104). `sendError` is separate from the read's `error`, is cleared only when the next send starts, and is drawn whether or not messages exist. `tests/chat-send.spec.ts` checks that a refresh after a refusal leaves it in place, and `tests/chat.test.ts` checks it through the real console.
2. ADDRESSED (hooks/chat-msg.ts:162-170). The mapping drops user rows with no text and assistant rows with no text and no tools, and keeps tool-only assistant rows as "… used <tools>". `tests/chat-host.spec.ts` uses a realistic tool-loop transcript. `tests/chat-view.spec.ts` checks that only one "you" frame is drawn, and `tests/chat.test.ts` checks the result body is not shown.
3. ADDRESSED (hooks/views/chat.ts:~28-31, 47-52, 118-120). A `clean()` helper calls `termText` on every body line, the tool line and the streamed partial. `tests/chat-view.spec.ts` covers ANSI, a bidi override and an invite code, for both messages and the partial.
4. ADDRESSED (hooks/chat.ts:39-45, 253-282; hooks/views/chat.ts:111-125; hooks/bindings.ts:412).
   - The draft lives in a WeakMap outside `Chat`, `State` and the snapshot, and the Input is controlled through `value` and `onInput`.
   - The draft is emptied only on an accepted send, and only if the field still equals the sent text, so text typed meanwhile survives. A refusal keeps it.
   - A repeated Enter while pending sets the fixed note "already sending — wait for it", which is cleared when the send settles.
5. ADDRESSED (tests/chat.test.ts, new). It has five tests:
   - open shows the messages, with no empty frame and no result body;
   - Enter submits once, the repeated Enter shows the note, and the field empties;
   - a refusal stays visible and the field keeps the text;
   - `console_state` carries counts only;
   - with Session preview off no text is drawn and the field is absent.
6. ADDRESSED (hooks/chat.ts:~140-142). `appendPartial` returns early when `sessionPreview` is off. `tests/chat-store.spec.ts` covers both off and on, and `tests/chat-gate.spec.ts` was adjusted to match.
7. ADDRESSED.
   - (a) hooks/register.ts maps a `{drop}` answer to `{ isDropped: true }` without the reason, and hooks/chat.ts:~268-272 shows the fixed "not sent: a hook declined it" and keeps the draft. `tests/chat-host.spec.ts` and `tests/chat-send.spec.ts` cover it, including that the reason and text are not echoed.
   - (b) `chatStep` calls `observe('\n')` once before the first text chunk of a step with `index > 0`, and the view strips a leading newline from the partial. Tests cover a later step and a step with no text.
   - (c) The stale comment in hooks/register.ts is rewritten.
   - (d) Tests cover a consumer's early `return()` reaching the upstream `finally` (main and subagent) and an upstream throw propagating.

**Implementer notes**
- Refused text kept in the in-memory draft table: acceptable. `draftOf` and `setDraft` appear only in hooks/chat.ts, hooks/views/chat.ts and the `chat.draft` binding in hooks/bindings.ts. The value is passed only as the Input's `value`, which is not part of the children `linesOf` walks, so text dumps, `console_state` and "Ask Claude" don't include it. It never goes into `Chat`, `State`, an event, a model call or an export. The only gap is that `tests/chat.test.ts` does not assert that the draft stays out of `console_state`.
- Help topic not updated: acceptable. The `chat` topic in hooks/help-topics-core.ts:210-224 says "after a check for secrets; mid-turn it queues". That is still true, but it doesn't mention the field emptying after a send, the kept text and "not sent" line after a refusal, or the "already sending" note. Adding one line would be nice, but it isn't wrong.
- The ask-claude spec timeout in a full run: acceptable. Run alone, `tests/ask-claude.spec.ts` passes 10/10. In the `chat-send.spec.ts` run, "ask Claude keeps submitting without asUser" took 1424 ms, so it is slow under load.

**New breakage in the fix diff:** none.

**Out-of-scope observations**
- `setDraft(state, text)` in `sendChat` stores the untrimmed text but compares trimmed text with `message`, so a text with surrounding whitespace is re-set on every send. This is harmless.
- `termText(line, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, false)` assumes the second argument is a length cap and the third is not a mode that matters here. I confirmed only through the passing tests that the cleaning works.

**Verdict:** all findings addressed.
